title: keraudrenia macrantha
intro: Keraudrenia macrantha, commonly known as the "forest gentian", is a plant species in the family Gentianaceae. It is a shrub-like plant native to the tropical regions of Africa, particularly in Cameroon and Gabon. The health benefits of Keraudrenia macrantha include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoids, gentiopicroside, and loganin, and have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
